title: Onboarding that continues with you
lede: Required setup saves to the account across web and iPhone. Real two-way handoff, photo-free completion and physical photo upload evidence for the Monday student rollout.

stats.n: Real invited synthetic students; physical iPhone 18 Pro Max.
PhotosPicker, pan/pinch, Save, server object and real web profile.
Claude’s reviewed Home, API, style and Accountability work included.

sections.heading: Final hosted regression passed
sections.note: Exact source 09561456e, required CI 39843245683 and Managed previews 39844352154. Real invited synthetic accounts in the owned preview; no fixture API. Native source is identical to the signed and physically tested 84586e71f candidate.

shots.title: One Continue reaches Photo
shots.cap: The real first save response is held after committing. A newer typed apparel answer is saved, and one Continue advances only after that newer answer is acknowledged. Photo-free Finish then succeeds.

shots.title: The physical upload survives the final deployment
shots.cap: Normal web sign-in renders the same photo saved from the physical iPhone. The actual object is still 512×512 WebP with both technical-image colors.

shots.title: Native Finish remains complete on the final server
shots.cap: The student who finished on iPhone without a photo remains complete, with the saved apparel answers preserved.

sections.heading: Real answers continue on either device
sections.note: Authenticated after-only evidence from the branch-owned Managed preview at 84586e71f. New synthetic students; no fixture API. Web → physical iPhone resumes a partial Wiscard. iPhone → web resumes the saved phone, Wiscard and year at Apparel. Finishing without a photo survives relaunch.

shots.title: Leave iPhone at Apparel
shots.cap: Phone, Wiscard and Sophomore are confirmed before the app terminates. Clothing and shoe choices remain independent.

shots.title: Resume the native draft on web
shots.cap: Normal web sign-in resumes at Apparel with the native contact, Wiscard and year already saved.

shots.title: Web sees the native Finish
shots.cap: The student who finished on iPhone without a photo stays complete when signing into web.

sections.heading: The physical photo is saved and visible on web
sections.note: Physical iPhone 18 Pro Max, iOS 27.2, isolated Creative Preview app. Only the marked orange/teal test image is selected, with a color guard before Save. The stored public object is fetched without preview authorization headers and verified as 512×512 WebP.

shots.title: Real PhotosPicker and gestures
shots.cap: A fresh marked sample is selected through the system picker, pinched and panned before Save.

shots.title: Native profile after Save
shots.cap: The confirmed photo is visible in Profile; Change photo appears and the crop sheet has dismissed.

shots.title: The same image on web
shots.cap: Real profile render plus stored-image format, dimensions and distinctive pixel checks pass.

sections.heading: Interrupted saves retain the answer
sections.note: Authenticated two-browser recovery passes against the same preview: a committed save whose response was dropped, independent group edits, both conflict decisions, and offline retention with automatic reconnect.

shots.title: Offline input remains visibly unsaved
shots.cap: The typed answer remains in memory with an offline banner and Retry save. Reconnect persists it without losing the independently saved Wiscard.

shots.title: Native apparel at accessibility size
shots.cap: The current native controls remain reachable while scrolling, and one Continue reaches the optional photo. Fixture UI evidence.

sections.heading: Move the photo itself
sections.note: After-only evidence. No sliders. A circular guide preserves photo context; iOS uses native pan/pinch and web supports drag, pinch, scroll and keyboard controls. Technical fixture images are used instead of student photos.

shots.title: Native photo crop
shots.cap: iPhone 18 Pro Max: system pan/pinch, Cancel, Save and a quiet Reset. VoiceOver offers zoom and movement actions.

shots.title: Web photo crop
shots.cap: Desktop: direct dragging and cursor-anchored wheel zoom. Small minus/plus buttons and keyboard commands support mouse and keyboard use.

shots.title: Web touch crop
shots.cap: Phone browser: actual two-finger pinch exercised. The same editor is used in onboarding, Settings and roster photo changes.

sections.heading: An interrupted upload keeps your crop
sections.note: The simulated server failure remains visible. Retry reuses the selected framing; upload bytes are checked against the selected off-center preview region.

shots.title: Native retry
shots.cap: The crop stays open and Save becomes available again after an unconfirmed upload.

shots.title: Web retry
shots.cap: The actual upload error appears without discarding the photo or its adjustments.

sections.heading: Earlier physical crop recovery regression
sections.note: Earlier synthetic fixture evidence found and fixed stale SwiftUI gesture feedback. Drag retains pinch zoom, failed Save preserves the exact crop pixels, and Reset restores the original. Actual shared-backend upload evidence is shown above.

shots.title: Physical crop after pinch and drag
shots.cap: System UIScrollView owns pan/pinch. Explicit commands drive Reset and VoiceOver; gesture changes are not echoed back as older zoom values.

shots.title: Physical failed-save recovery
shots.cap: The crop remains identical after the simulated failure. Save freezes the export adjustment and stops remaining motion.

shots.title: A real system photo selection
shots.cap: The physical phone added and selected the marked technical sample through PhotosPicker, verified its decoded colors and cancelled cleanly. The personal photo-library grid is excluded. Successful shared-backend upload is recorded above.

sections.heading: Saved answers and explicit conflict recovery
sections.note: Valid field groups save to the account; incomplete private text stays in memory and is shown as unsaved. Changes elsewhere never silently overwrite local edits.

shots.title: Saved apparel answers
shots.cap: Clothing and shoe sizing are independent Men’s/Women’s choices. Custom sizes remain editable.

shots.title: Saved-answer conflict
shots.cap: Choose the saved answers or explicitly save the retained edits using the latest version.

shots.title: Native apparel
shots.cap: The refreshed native Welcome design is retained, with save status visible under the header.

shots.title: Native apparel confirmation
shots.cap: The summary reflects the selected clothing and shoe sizes separately.

sections.heading: Photo is optional; Finish is durable
sections.note: Both clients send FINISH after required information is complete, including when no photo is selected. A persisted completion receipt prevents a future session from reopening Welcome for the missing photo.

shots.title: Optional web photo
shots.cap: Finish works without a photo; all required answers have already been acknowledged.

shots.title: Optional native photo
shots.cap: The photo can be added later from native Profile.

shots.title: Finished without photo
shots.cap: The native fixture reaches the final Welcome screen after the photo-free completion response.

changes.was: Separate sliders controlled zoom and each movement axis.
changes.now: The image is the interaction surface. System pan/pinch on iOS and drag/pinch/scroll on web keep the photo under direct control.

changes.was: Complete-step writes and photo-dependent completion could make interrupted setup or skipped photos ambiguous.
changes.now: Validated field groups, explicit conflict choices and a durable Finish receipt keep the saved state and completion decision separate.

changes.was: A request could be interrupted or arrive after another device changed the photo.
changes.now: Frozen photo/account versions and upload IDs reject stale replacements and reconcile confirmed uploads. The old image is deleted only after the new pointer and audit commit.

verification: 6,571 source/service tests pass, one existing skip. TypeScript, app build, migration prefixes and docs checks pass. Lint has zero errors and 55 existing warnings.

All seven real-browser component cases pass. The in-flight edit case clicks Continue once before releasing the response; it fails on the old hook. The same delayed-save regression passes against the final hosted server at 09561456e.

Final source 09561456e passes required CI and Managed previews. Authenticated handoff-data preservation, real photo read-back, one-click Continue, photo-free Finish and lost-response/conflict/offline recovery pass on that deployment.

273 native unit tests pass on iPhone 18 Pro Max. Five combined simulator UI cases cover required setup, photo skip, direct crop/retry, large-text apparel and Home interaction. The isolated physical runner builds and the live handoff/photo cases pass.
WisconsinKiosk compiles at a generic simulator destination. The required iPadOS 26.5 runtime is unavailable; no kiosk runtime claim is made.

Two independent source reviews found no remaining native integration or required-setup/privacy/migration defects. Wrapped frozen identity redaction and the exact applied migration-name exception have focused coverage.

Signed/exported 1.4 build 36 passes deep strict signature verification and App Store publish dry run. Native source is unchanged by the final web-only save fix. No IPA bytes were uploaded and nothing was submitted or distributed.
Mobbin MCP references informed the circular crop guide, image context and brief guidance. Still images establish presentation; our runtime tests exercise the gestures.
notes: All captures are labeled after-only; no trustworthy matched pre-change baseline or measured visual/performance improvement is claimed. Component fixtures and authenticated backend evidence are identified separately.

The physical handoff/upload source is 84586e71f. The final web/server source 09561456e confirms the Continue fix and preserved physical results. Main’s subsequent backend extraction and tokenless source-map build repair leave the native tree unchanged.

The account-completion migration is applied only in the branch-owned preview. Production migration/deployment and App Store/native distribution require the release step. Synthetic preview students were created without email.

Claude’s reviewed #605, remaining #601 logging/build changes and #610 Accountability are included, alongside current main. Required onboarding, diagnostic, damage-report and avatar recovery contracts are retained.
The original dirty checkout is preserved. The physical test app has separate bundle and app-group identities; no personal photo grid is included in selected evidence.
Xcode’s local App Store export validation registered an AWAITING_UPLOAD record; the exact ID was confirmed in its distribution log. This is distinct from uploading the IPA or distributing an app.
The browser refused the local file protocol. HTML structure, embedded image references, alt text and selected source images were inspected directly; no alternate protocol workaround was used.
